# pm-facing_alias: # Schema: PM-facing alias, wire-format model id, reasoning effort.
# This file is the opencode-executor alias table.
# Columns must be tab-separated.
# Wire IDs use the opencode provider prefix (opencode/ = OpenCode Zen free
# tier). Unknown aliases are passed through as-is to the opencode CLI —
# any raw wire ID (e.g. opencode/big-pickle, openrouter/nvidia/...) works
# without needing an entry here.
# reasoning_effort is recorded for future use; opencode does not currently
# expose a reasoning-effort flag, so it is informational only.
# Default model: pm-dispatch pins Nemotron 3 Ultra Free as the primary
# dispatcher model when no --model is given. This is also the head of the
# fallback_chain in adapter.yaml. Override per-host via
# ~/.pm-dispatch/config `dispatch.default_model`.
# Free models rotate: checked with `opencode run -m opencode/<id>` on
# opencode 1.19.3 (2026-10-21). Gone since the previous table: deepseek-v4-flash-free,
# mimo-v2.5-free, north-mini-code-free (they now fail at the provider).
default
light
nemotron
lightning
deepseek
mimo
glm
bigpickle
